items.title: Maximum-Severity SSRF Flaw in SonicWall SMA Devices Under Attack
items.summary: Attackers are currently targeting a critical vulnerability in SMA 1000 appliances, putting SonicWall customers in a familiar yet unenviable position.

items.title: Prominent Ransomware Negotiator Faces Extortion Charges
items.summary: Edward Dubrovsky, a longtime cybersecurity executive, was arrested and charged in Pennsylvania last week under conspiracy to extort money.

items.title: No Identity, No Recovery: Cyber Resilience Starts With IAM
